items.name: Borrowers must have a valid Minuteman Library Network card in good standing
Borrowers of Library of Things items must be 18 years old or older
Borrowers will receive a copy of the Library of Things Lending Agreement
Borrowers must pick up and return the Library of Things item at the Needham Free Public Library Circulation Desk
